summary: How an element bot picks its next move (NpcBending; Tidebreak, the ring sport: the owner, 2026-10-04, the bots cast the same moves as the player). Every (move, mode) of its element's kit (round 2's skills: Bending.keys' 1-5, its guard on E and its jab: moves.json guards, jabs) is an option; each is scored every think by its role (offence, control, defence, mobility, reaction, sustain, setup), the element's personality, its range band and its 'when' (the need it answers), then a little chance (the bot's own seeded rng). Lock times are the player's own (SwayCaster's rule: the move's lock_s or mode_lock_s x the expert tier's mastery.lock_mult x the preset's lock_mult; a move's ai_factor only on easy and normal). Every number here is tuned by eye and by the soak (tests/ring/test_ring_soak.gd).

_doc.defaults: By the spec's do (the move's mode in data/sway/moves.json): role, range_m [near, far] (a number past 1 is metres; 'spec' takes the spec's own range_m or radius_m), cool_s (how long before it picks the same option again). An unknown do is treated as 'bolt'.
_doc.zones: A zone's role by its kind (spec.zone): the guards answer what flies at it (answers: attack kinds), the barriers are defence, the ground and the moving ones control.
_doc.moves: Per move, then per mode: what overrides the defaults (role, range_m, when, answers, cool_s, weight, grow (the chance a spec that grows is held to grow), way (a dash whose way is the keys held: 'side', 'back', 'forward'), combo {after: 'move/mode', bonus}). when: hurt (struck within hurt_s, or under half health), close (the foe within close_m), far (past far_m), stone_near, own_wall, own_damaged_wall, near_pool, foe_airborne, foe_grounded, foe_up_or_walled (in the air, or a wall on the line between: the High Kick's arc clears it), holding (a caught stone held), room_back, edge_behind, airborne, foe_far. answers on an option of any role makes it a guard too (NpcBending.is_guard: begun against a threat of those kinds as a reaction is), with min_knock (the threat's knock_mps at least this) and guard_when; a dash only with room for it. Threat kinds past the attacks': held (a stone held up and aimed at it), vortex (a tornado), floor (a Boulder rolling along the deck: jumped), under (a Column or a Geyser being cast at it: stepped off by a dash). A wave along the deck (the Kick's floor wave) is its element's kind for the guards and jumped as well (jump_*). Round 2: the moves the kits cut are gone from here.
_doc.old: The Sway's old spells (no bend spec: stone_form spike and cannonball, earth_wall wall, pillar self, mend): BendCast.cast casts them when it is there; without it only spike and wall are cast (NpcBending's own fallbacks).
_doc.elements: Each element's personality: a multiplier per role (and 'knock' for options whose knock_mps is 8 or more), react (x the preset's react_chance: how often a threat is answered at all; one roll a volley: NpcBending.VOLLEY_S), grow (the chance a move that grows is held to grow) and the range band it keeps between casts (keep_m).
_doc.presets: The difficulty: reaction_s (from a threat seen to its answer begun), guard_reaction_s (the same for its own guard on E: a reflex on his wind-up, so even an easy bot guards some shots; KITS round 2), scatter_deg (one sigma of the aim's line), lead (the share of a moving foe's lead taken), lock_mult (x the player's lock), ai_factor (the move's ai_factor applied: easy and normal only), react_chance (a threat answered at all), perfect_chance (an answered threat met on the beat: in the guard's first guard_rules.perfect_s; else late, half through; round 2, spec 8.1: easy 0.1, normal 0.3, hard 0.6), jump_chance (a wave along the deck jumped), lightning_dash (a dash on a lightning's flash), rest_s (between one release and the next lock), think_s, grace_s (the opening: no attack or control begun and nothing that knocks; guards and footwork only).
_doc.jump: The floor rule (spec 2.8: along the floor? jump): jump_mps the bot's jump (m/s up at its gravity 18: its feet over 0.6 m from about 0.1 s to 0.6 s after), jump_lead_s the takeoff that long before the wave reaches its feet.

_guard_cool_s: after any guard begun (a reaction: catch, deflect, shield, spin, redirect...), no other guard for this long past its lock (s): one guard after another of whatever kind turtles (the soak, 2026-10-05: an air bot answered every fire bolt with return, spin and shield in turn)
